Revenue is primarily driven by marketplace transaction fees, seller services, payments-related economics, subscriptions/listing products, and promoted listings/advertising. The model depends on GMV, buyer and seller liquidity, take rate, search and discovery quality, trust and safety, advertising adoption, and seller ROI.
llm_synthesis.business_quality_assessment: Business quality is above average for a consumer discretionary internet marketplace because eBay has high gross margins, recurring marketplace liquidity, limited inventory risk, and strong free-cash-flow potential. LTM gross margin is 72.5%, operating margin is 20.5%, EBITDA margin is 26.6%, and free-cash-flow margin is 20.2% using supplied yfinance financial context. The main quality offsets are relatively mature marketplace growth, competition from larger marketplaces and vertical platforms, possible buyer/seller attrition, and reliance on continued monetization without harming seller economics or buyer conversion.

company_profile.business_description: eBay Inc. operates a global online marketplace that connects buyers and sellers across new, used, refurbished, collectible, and hard-to-find goods. The company’s platform supports consumer-to-consumer and business-to-consumer commerce, with meaningful exposure to categories such as parts and accessories, collectibles, fashion, electronics, home and garden, and refurbished goods. eBay’s economics are primarily marketplace-based: it facilitates transactions rather than owning most inventory, generating revenue from transaction fees, seller services, payments-related fees, and advertising products.
company_profile.business_model: eBay is an asset-light, two-sided marketplace business. Sellers list inventory on the platform and pay fees when items are listed, sold, promoted, or supported by seller tools; buyers use the marketplace to discover and purchase goods. The model depends on marketplace liquidity, buyer traffic, seller supply, trust and safety, search/recommendation quality, payments functionality, and category-specific vertical experiences. Because eBay generally does not take inventory risk for third-party marketplace sales, gross margins can be structurally high, while profitability is driven by GMV, take rate, advertising penetration, operating expense discipline, payment/fraud costs, technology investment, and marketing efficiency.
